moat_against: Hardware cyclicality — revenue fell ~21% in the FY2023 downturn
Honeywell and lower-cost Android device makers contest every refresh cycle
Component/memory (DRAM) supply constraints are a recurring cost headwind
Current reported growth is flattered by the Elo acquisition rather than purely organic demand
moat_for: Market leadership in rugged mobile computing, scanning, and printing with a large installed base
Zebra DNA software platform and device-management integration raise switching costs
Global sales/service channel and support network entrants cannot quickly replicate
Demonstrated pricing power — Q2 2026 gross margin 53.0%
moat_justification: Clear share leader in enterprise mobile computing, scanning, and printing with an installed base, Zebra DNA software integration, and a global service/channel network creating real switching friction and demonstrated pricing power (Q2 2026 gross margin 53.0%). Not wide: products are cyclical hardware tied to customer capex (revenue fell ~21% in FY2023), Honeywell and low-cost device makers contest refresh cycles, and memory/component supply is a recurring cost headwind.
name: Zebra Technologies Corporation
one_liner: Solid AIDC franchise, moat 6/10, but at $380.50 the weighted IRR is only 8.4% — it clears 15% only near $169, and even the super-bull IV@15 ($345) is below today's price.
